name: Börcs (Hungary)
description: A vertical white banner charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Börcs (a red and blue shield with a patriarchal cross, a wavy stripe and a bunch of grapes) between the words BÖRCS above and KÖZSÉG below in yellow.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
